name: Loadout Waypoints
description: Plan and track your training: exercises, workouts and progress.

settings.label: Time zone
settings.help: For example America/New_York. Leave empty for UTC. It affects dates, scheduled backups and "This week".

settings.label: Mail server
settings.help: Needed for "Forgot your password?". Without it an administrator has to reset passwords. Values here override the ones saved in Loadout under Admin > Settings.

settings.label: Secure connection
settings.help: Leave on Automatic unless your mail server needs otherwise.

settings.label: Largest backup to restore (GB)
settings.help: How large a full-site backup may be once unpacked. Raise it only if your backups really are larger.

settings.label: Largest data file inside an import (MB)
Keep uploaded images and videos

options.label: In an S3-compatible bucket (S3, R2, B2)

settings.help: Choosing a bucket also needs the bucket details below. Existing media is not moved for you.

settings.label: Bucket region
settings.help: auto for Cloudflare R2, a real region for AWS.

settings.label: Tailscale key
settings.help: Joins your tailnet at start, so log export and Pushgateway can reach private addresses.

settings.label: Keep a copy of saved settings in the database
settings.help: For hosts that replace their disk on every deploy.

settings.label: Full database connection string
settings.help: For example mongodb+srv://... Leave empty to use the bundled database. When set, the bundled one is not used.

settings.label: Database version
settings.help: Only change this for a Raspberry Pi 4 or older. On an install that already has data, switching versions can stop the database from starting.

insideApp: The public hostname, email, logging, metrics and LDAP details can also be set inside Loadout, under Admin > Settings. What is saved there takes priority over what the Gateway sets.
Exercise and plan libraries are managed inside Loadout.

storage.label: Database
storage.help: Your plans, workouts and progress. The most important one.

storage.label: Uploaded images and videos
storage.help: Exercise media. Ignored if you keep media in an S3 bucket.

storage.label: Backups
storage.help: Full-site backups. Best kept on a different disk from the database.

storage.label: Secrets
storage.help: Keys and the first admin password the app made for itself. Keep them with your backups.

storage.label: Log files
storage.help: Records of what the app did.

postInstall: On first start Loadout creates an administrator password. Read it with: docker logs loadoutwaypoints-app
